description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and storage options related to Azure Table Storage integration for Orleans transactions. It defines configuration options, validators, storage factory and storage implementation classes for managing transactional state using Azure Table storage.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Table transactional state, including table name and initialization stage.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator for AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions ensuring correct configuration.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptions
classes.description: Base class for Azure Storage operation options, including table client and service client configurations.

classes.name: AzureStorageOperationOptionsValidator`1
classes.description: Generic validator class for Azure Storage options.

classes.name: AzureStoragePolicyOptions
classes.description: Policy settings for Azure Storage operations like retries and timeouts.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage for specific grain states.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorage`1
classes.description: Implementation of transactional state storage using Azure Tables.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Extension methods to add Azure Table transactional state storage to silo builder (overloads for configuration).

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Extension methods to set Azure Table transactional state storage as the default in silo builder.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an ITransactionalStateStorageFactory instance.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a transactional state storage instance for a given grain state type and context.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Method to participate in the silo lifecycle, typically for cleanup or startup tasks.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the transactional state from Azure Table storage.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores or commits transactional state updates to Azure Table storage.

methods.name: ConfigureTableServiceClient
methods.description: Various obsolete methods to configure the TableServiceClient directly.
